# Experiment: Product structured data with aggregateRating

**Period:** 2026-04-01 → 2026-05-15 on 200 product pages with at least 5 reviews; 200 comparable pages as control.

**Result:** review stars appeared on 84% of test pages within two weeks; clicks +12%, CTR +0.6 points, no position change. Rolled out to the whole catalogue in June.
